items.title: Anthropic researcher claims Claude helped him prove the Riemann hypothesis
items.summary:
Mmathematician at Anthropic says he has used the company’s Claude AI model to prove the Riemann hypothesis, one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics. Levent Alpöge made the claim in a note on his website on Friday, Bloomberg reported. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” […]

items.title: Why You Should Try Gemini Neon (Even if You Love Fable)
items.summary: The day after Anthropic's record IPO, the most interesting story is a Google model. Gemini 4 Neon is winning over skeptics, and the case for using it is less that it beats Fable or Astra and more that it doesn't think like them.

items.title: Taiwan widens its short-selling ban after the Taiex’s worst week since 1991
items.summary:
Taiwan’s financial regulator has banned all short selling of local stocks below the previous day’s closing price. The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) announced the move on Saturday, Bloomberg reported. It takes effect on 23 November. Short selling is a bet that a share price will fall.
